title: Gearhead's 'Each Equipment attached to me gives double its base Might bonus' is not applied
expected: Reproduced with the harness: scenario with Gearhead (sfd-068-221) in base + Skyfall (+2) gear; after `equipCard` + settle, game.state("gh") shows might=5, staticMightBonus=0, equippedWith=["sky"] (expected 7). The parser emits the correct static ({type:"modify-might", source:"equipment", multiplier:2} — static-parser.ts:817-834) and static-abilities.ts:518-537 does implement the (multiplier-1)×base doubling, but it never runs after equipping: the equipCard reducer (game-definition/moves/equipment.ts:112-151) only calls fireTriggers({type:"attach-equipment"}) at line 142 directly — not dispatchEvent / cleanupAndFireDeaths — and equipmentMoves are not wrapped in withPostMoveCleanup, and "attach-equipment" is absent from EVENT_TYPES_NEEDING_RECALC (events/dispatcher.ts:82-112). So recalculateStaticEffects is not invoked and staticMightBonus stays 0 → 3+2=5. Note: with current code a subsequent standardMove (movement.ts is wrapped in withPostMoveCleanup) does recalc to 7, so the "still 5 after standardMove" sub-observation no longer reproduces (the static-abilities.ts handling landed in cbd38e3 today), but the primary defect — Gearhead reads 5 not 7 immediately after equipCard — is confirmed.
observed: After equipCard (Doran's Blade -> Gearhead), meta showed equippedWith=[Doran's Blade], equipmentMightBonus=2, staticMightBonus=0; card tile displayed 5 Might. Still 5 after a subsequent standardMove (recalc opportunity).
